name: Hierarchical Chunk LOD System
definition: A recursive Level of Detail (LOD) system using octree-like chunk subdivision. Chunks split into 8 children when close to the viewer and merge when far away, maintaining a consistent surface approximation across different distances.
summary: A recursive Level of Detail system using octree-like chunk subdivision that dynamically splits or merges chunks based on viewer distance to maintain consistent surface approximation and interactive rates.
